# Brics24 News on Instagram: "Kano gets its railway date. Nigeria says the Kaduna-Kano line is about 90% built and will open on 3 …"

Kano gets its railway date.
Nigeria says the Kaduna-Kano line is about 90% built and will open on 3 December, together with 250 km of the Kano-Katsina route. Three years ago the first stood below 30%.
